name: Udhaar
tagline: Keep track of who owes you and whom you owe. Send a polite UPI reminder in one tap.
description: Udhaar is a simple lending ledger for money you give to or get from friends, family and colleagues. Add people, note what you gave or got with an amount, a note and a date, and see each person's balance and your totals at a glance. Set a due date to get a notification on the day. Send a polite reminder through WhatsApp or any app, with a UPI payment link that has your own UPI ID and the amount. When you owe someone whose UPI ID you saved, pay them with one tap. Settle up clears a balance, and you can export everything as a CSV file. It works fully offline and everything stays on your phone.
